home.heroTitle: Find a personal trainer near you
home.heroSubtitle: Browse local personal trainers, athletic coaches and online coaches. Preview their social feed, compare rates, and contact them directly.
home.whatIsBody1: Choosing a trainer from a Google search or an Instagram hashtag is a shot in the dark — you can't easily compare specialties, rates, or locations side by side.
home.whatIsBody2: FitnessMode puts local trainers, coaches, and online professionals in one place. Browse by city and modality, preview each trainer's real work through their social feeds, and message them directly when you're ready.
home.badge1: Free to browse — no account needed
home.badge2: See real client results on their social feeds
home.badge3: Contact trainers directly — no markups on your sessions
home.whatIsImageAlt: A person browsing trainer profile cards with location pins and social media icons
home.featuredSubtitle: See someone you like? Open their profile and message them today.
home.step1Body: Filter by modality — at home, gym, outdoor or online — specialty and rate. No account needed.
home.step2Body: Jump straight to a trainer's Instagram or TikTok to see their style and real client results.
home.step3Body: Message the trainer on their channels. Zero commission, zero middlemen.
home.ctaBody: Get a free profile page that ranks on local Google search and sends clients straight to your Instagram or TikTok. Keep 100% of what you earn.
home.ctaImageAlt: A personal trainer creating their FitnessMode profile card

forTrainers.metaDescription: Create a free FitnessMode profile and get discovered by clients searching for personal trainers in your city. Zero commission.
forTrainers.heroTitle: Grow your personal training business for free
forTrainers.heroSubtitle: Create a free profile on FitnessMode and get discovered by clients searching for trainers in your city. No commission, no monthly fees.
forTrainers.step1Body: Add your photo, headline, bio, specialties, and the channels where clients can reach you.
forTrainers.step2Body: Show up when people search your city, modality, or specialty. No ads or bidding required.
forTrainers.step3Body: Clients click straight through to your Instagram, TikTok, website, or contact details. You keep 100%.
forTrainers.ctaBody: Join other trainers who use FitnessMode to turn local search traffic into direct bookings.
